candidate_evidence.quote: Regorafenib+Nivolumab: Parallel-cohort in adult participants with selected recurrent or metastatic tumors (HNSCC, ESCC, PDAC, BTC, and GBM/AA)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: with unequivocal first progression after surgery followed by radiotherapy and temozolomide.
